conversation_summary: The shopper is interested in a T-shirt made from 70% certified organic cotton and 30% TENCEL™ Lyocell, which is lightweight, breathable, and soft-touch. They are 170 centimeters tall and prefer a wide fit, considering their usual size or possibly sizing up for a looser feel. The selected color is white, viewed as versatile and stylish. The shopper confirmed their intent to purchase and appreciated the conversation. Nova highlighted the T-shirt's certifications, including GOTS for organic cotton and OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 for safety and sustainability, along with sustainable production methods. The shopper did not raise any objections and inquired about care instructions, which Nova provided, recommending washing in cold water inside-out and line drying. The conversation ended positively, with the shopper expressing gratitude and indicating they may have further questions or need assistance in the future.
